title: FROD: Feature Matching Residual Denoising Oracle Bone Decipher
abstract: arXiv:2609.17227v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Oracle bone script (OBS), one of the earliest Chinese writing systems, plays an important role in the study of Chinese etymology. Traditional decipherment relies heavily on domain experts who analyze characters through semantic context and structural evolution. To assist this labor-intensive process, we formulate OBS decipherment assistance as a cross-era image translation task and propose FROD (Feature Matching Residual Denoising Oracle Bone Decipher). Although many OBS characters differ substantially from their modern counterparts, they often preserve local topological invariants at the radical level. During training, FROD leverages fast feature matching to provide gated segmentation supervision: paired samples with sufficient matches are processed patch-wise to align fine-grained radicals, whereas low-similarity pairs are trained holistically to avoid mismatched artifacts. translated_title: FROD：基于特征匹配残差去噪的甲骨文释读方法
translated_abstract: 甲骨文（OBS）是最早的汉字书写系统之一，在汉字词源学研究中占有重要地位。传统的释读工作严重依赖于领域专家通过语义语境和字形结构演变来分析文字。为了辅助这一劳动密集型的过程，我们将甲骨文释读辅助任务表述为一个跨时代图像翻译任务，并提出了FROD（特征匹配残差去噪甲骨文释读）方法。尽管许多甲骨文字与现代对应字形存在显著差异，但它们通常在部首层面保留了局部拓扑不变性。在训练过程中，FROD利用快速特征匹配提供门控分割监督：对于匹配充分的配对样本，采用分块处理方式对齐细粒度部首；而对于低相似度的配对样本，则进行整体训练以避免不匹配产生的伪影。此外，残差去噪扩散模型（RDDM）联合（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FROD方法，将甲骨文释读辅助建模为跨时代图像翻译任务，通过特征匹配门控分割监督与残差去噪扩散模型相结合，实现甲骨文字形向现代汉字的转换以辅助专家释读。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FROD, which formulates oracle bone script decipherment assistance as a cross-era image translation task, combining feature-matching gated segmentation supervision with a residual denoising diffusion model to transform oracle bone characters into modern Chinese characters.
